en.summary: A private, safety-first iCloud Mail MCP implementation with a public blueprint.
en.description: The production implementation is private; the provider-neutral secure-mail blueprint enables compatible implementations without private source access.
en.limitations: Production OAuth and account configuration are private. Permanent deletion is not supported.

zh.summary: 一个以安全为先的私有 iCloud Mail MCP 实现，并提供公开蓝图。
zh.description: 生产实现保持私有；与提供商无关的安全邮件蓝图让开发者无需访问私有源码也能构建兼容实现。
zh.limitations: 生产 OAuth 与账户配置为私有；不支持永久删除。
